extName.description: Extension name, shown in Chrome and in the store listing.

extDescription.message: Sends the videos playing in your browser to the Universal Downloader app on this computer.
extDescription.description: Extension description, at most 132 characters. Must not promise what any site will allow.

popupTitle.description: Heading of the popup, above the list of videos the current tab plays.

btnDownload.description: Button on each row. Hands the video to the app, which opens it so the quality can be chosen there. Kept to a short word: the popup is 340 px wide, and a longer label cuts the row's quality and length short.

btnSent.description: Replaces the Get button once the app has taken the video.

kindStream.description: Meta line label for an HLS or DASH stream.

kindPage.description: Meta line label for a row that hands over the page's address itself.

kindLive.description: First word of a row's details when the app says the video is a live broadcast.

kindProtected.description: Meta line of a row whose video is DRM-protected. Such a row has no button.

emptyBody.message: Play the video and it shows up here.

noticeUpdate.description: The installed app is older than this extension.

linkTitle.description: Title of the switch that lends this profile's YouTube sign-in to the app.

linkOffHint.description: Under the YouTube switch while it is off: what turning it on is for.

linkOther.description: Under either switch while another browser profile holds the connection. Turning the switch on here takes it over.

tiktokTitle.description: Title of the switch that lends this profile's TikTok sign-in to the app. Shown on TikTok pages, and on any page while it is on.

tiktokOn.description: Under the TikTok switch while it is on and the app holds a current TikTok sign-in.

tiktokSignedOut.description: Under the TikTok switch while it is on but the browser is not signed in to TikTok.

tiktokOffHint.description: Under the TikTok switch while it is off: what turning it on is for.

otherTitle.description: Title of the switch that lends the sign-in of the site Get is pressed on -- any site but YouTube and TikTok -- to the app, for that download. Shown on such sites' pages, and on any page while it is on.

otherOn.message: Only for the site you press Get on
otherOn.description: Under the Other sites switch while it is on: pressing Get on a page hands the app that one site's sign-in, for that download, and nothing else.

otherOffHint.description: Under the Other sites switch while it is off: what turning it on is for. The names are examples of sites, left untranslated.

rowSignIn.description: Details line of a row whose post TikTok shows only to signed-in viewers, while the TikTok switch is off or the browser is signed out. The Get button stays.

rowWithSession.description: Details line of a row whose post TikTok shows only to signed-in viewers, while the TikTok switch is on and the browser is signed in.

sessionsTitle.description: Heading on the welcome page, above the paragraph about the session switches.

step1Body.message: The app tells Chrome where to find it.

step2Body.message: On any site. The extension notices what the page plays.

step3Title.message: Click the toolbar icon, then Get

step3Body.message: Universal Downloader comes to the front with the video open, where you choose the quality and the watermark and download it.

welcomeSession.message: For members-only YouTube videos, turn on YouTube session in the popup; for age-restricted TikTok posts, TikTok session, which the popup shows on TikTok; for posts on other sites that only your account can see, Other sites, which lends the sign-in of the site you press Get on, for that download. Each lends only to the app on this computer, and stays off until you turn it on.
welcomeSession.description: Welcome page paragraph under the Sign-ins heading. The three switch names are the popup's titles for them.

pinBody.message: Chrome hides new extensions behind the puzzle-piece button next to the address bar. Click it, then the pin beside Universal Downloader Connector.

privacyBody.message: The extension sends nothing anywhere but to Universal Downloader on this computer, and the app downloads a video only when you choose to.
